patho.note: Nourrisson. Le poumon gauche, à droite de l'image, est trop clair et trop grand. Le médiastin est refoulé vers la droite du patient. Pas de nom.
patho.caption_source: The left lung is overinflated due to the valve effect of the foreign body in the left main bronchus. This caused the corresponding mediastinal shift to the right. The foreign body was removed on bronchoscopy before this chest X-ray was taken.
